name: 93514 · Bishop, CA
findings: ZIP 93514 (Bishop) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93514 (Bishop) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93514 (Bishop) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
